title: NOC Letter Template
description: Free NOC letter format from an employer in India with ref. no., employee details, purpose, leave dates, validity and authorised signatory. Edit it in Word, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Excel or Overleaf.
features: Company letterhead with reference number and date
Employee details table: ID, designation, joining date, PAN
Purpose, leave period, validity and verification contact
research: All references use company letterhead, a reference no. and date, a 'To whomsoever it may concern' address, a subject naming the employee, service period and purpose, a clear no-objection statement, and a signature with name, designation and company seal.

lines: [Plot 42, Industrial Area Phase II, Pune, Maharashtra 411019]
blocks.title: NO OBJECTION CERTIFICATE

blocks.text: **Subject: No Objection Certificate for [Mr. Rohan Mehta] for visa application and overseas travel**

text: This is to certify that [Mr. Rohan Mehta], son of [Mr. Suresh Mehta], is a permanent, full-time employee of [Sharma IT Solutions Pvt. Ltd.] and has been working with us since [01/07/2021]. He currently holds the position of [Senior Software Engineer] in our [Product Engineering] department, drawing an annual gross salary of [₹18,60,000]. His conduct and performance during his service have been good.

[Mr. Mehta] has applied for a [tourist visa to the United Kingdom] to travel with his family for a holiday. His leave from [20/12/2026] to [05/01/2027] has been approved by the company, and he is expected to resume duty on [06/01/2027]. His position will be kept open for him during this period.

The company has **no objection** to his applying for the visa and travelling abroad for the purpose stated above. The company does not take any financial responsibility for his travel; all expenses will be borne by the employee.

This certificate is issued at the request of the employee and is valid for [six months] from the date of issue, for the purpose mentioned above only. For any verification, please contact our HR department at [+91 98220 12345] or [hr@sharmait.in].

blocks.heading: Enclosures
text: 1. Copy of employee ID card  2. Last three months' salary slips  3. Approved leave letter

blocks.text: This letter is valid only with the company seal and the signature of an authorised signatory. Any alteration makes it void.
